title: Boundary-adjacent Unknown Type Identification
purpose: Keep the message valid while using a documented boundary-adjacent length, count, or quantity field.
expected_behavior: Parser accepts the boundary-adjacent length and count while remaining valid.
constraints_preserved: Prefer widely recognized FT1.2 or IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing.
Keep 0x68 length octets consistent with the selected frame size.
Diversify link control, interrogation, command and measurement paths.
issue_safety_notes: Safe test sequence avoiding any structural analogue of historical crash payloads
